name: dimensions_come_from_the_model
why: Entries Z-C1-bis and Z-E7, then Z-C21.2 finding M2. From 18/9/2026 model_dimensions was «the operation that never succeeds out of process» (Z-C1: 0 dimensions of 7), and its case could not be written, because a refusal without a green twin proves nothing. On 26/9 two out-of-process probes (prova0089 tolq, tolq2) saw it bring the model dimensions into the drawing, tolerances included: hence the real pair, the twin that refuses (a drawing without views) and the green case (the dimensions arrive). The 7 of that day were 4 model dimensions, 3 of them twice (M2, measured in Z-C21.3): InsertModelAnnotations3 was called with DuplicateDims = false and the comment «never duplicates», while IDrawingDoc~InsertModelAnnotations3.html says «DuplicateDims True to eliminate duplicate dimensions, false to allow duplicate dimensions». The fix passes true, and the same plate gets each dimension once.
defect_caught: The import that answers «done» with zero dimensions (the block of Z-C1, gone on 26/9 and able to come back); the refusal on a drawing without views that stops saying so; and the same model dimension placed in two views (M2): on library 0.141.0 the last step inserts 7 and the expectation of 4 is RED.
_the_numbers: Plate 120 x 80 x 10 centred on the top plane, hole Ø10 through: 96000 - pi x 5^2 x 10 = 95214.6 mm3. Four model dimensions, all marked for drawing by the bridge: the 120 and the 80 of the sketch, the depth 10, the Ø10 (cylindrical_cut places no position dimension). Probe probe_duplicate_dims, 28/9/2026, the same plate, three standard views, InsertModelAnnotations3 with the MARKED mask on all views: DuplicateDims false -> 7 (front: 120 and 10; top: 120, 80 and Ø10; side: 80 and 10; the 120, the 80 and the depth each twice), DuplicateDims true -> 4 (front: 10; top: 120, 80 and Ø10; side: none, no key twice); a second call on the same drawing adds 0 with either value.

expect.why: a view attaches to the FILE of the part

THE LINE THAT IS RED ON 0.141.0 (there it is 7). Each of the 4 model dimensions once: probe_duplicate_dims gave 4 with DuplicateDims true and 7 with false, the 120, the 80 and the depth 10 placed twice. Zero was the block of Z-C1
the 4 come from the first step, the MARKED mask on all views, the very call the probe measured: no fallback ran
the import does not touch the views
